subject: Fairy Ocarina
text: Saria gives Link the ocarina when he exits Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Now when you exit the forest Saria will give you the ocarina before you're allowed to completely leave.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS004
text: Gold Skulltula GS004 is found by rolling into the far right crate inside the room with the pots by the entrance.

evidence.quote: take the first right into the room with the pots.  Roll into the far right crate and kill [GS004].

subject: Deku Seeds Upgrade
text: Playing the Shooting Gallery game in the market awards the first Deku Seeds bullet bag upgrade.

evidence.quote: Walk to the building with the huge bulls-eye on the side and enter.  It's the shooting gallery, play the game and get the first upgrade for the Deku seeds.

subject: Weird Egg
text: Malon gives Link an egg when spoken to by the climbable vine on the Hyrule Castle screen.

evidence.quote: Walk back to the Hyrule Castle screen and you'll see Malon standing by the climbable vine.  Get the egg from her and put it on a C button.

subject: Piece of Heart PoH01
text: Returning the white dog from under the sunrise-watching man to the lady in the alley awards Piece of Heart PoH01.

evidence.quote: avoid the other dogs as you walk to the corner under the guy looking for the sunrise.  The white dog will follow you as you wander around.  Go into the alley and return the fat lady's dog in exchange for [PoH01].

subject: Piece of Heart PoH02
text: Winning the Treasure Chest Game yields Piece of Heart PoH02, which can be aided by watching chest seams for subtle pixel changes.

evidence.quote:
It's the Treasure Chest game...If you look closely  
at the seams of the treasure chest, you can see a few pixels change  
occasionally since the key spins around while it's in the chest and it's  
white, this will be your means of getting the piece of heart.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS005
text: Rolling into the tree where the owl was perched at Hyrule Castle reveals Gold Skulltula GS005.

evidence.quote:
As you near the  
tree the owl will start talking to you, once he's finished roll into the  
tree he was on for [GS005].

subject: Gold Skulltula GS006
text: Rolling into the first tree upon entering Kakariko Village reveals Gold Skulltula GS006.

evidence.quote:
Run across the field to Kakoriko village when you enter roll into  
the first tree (coincidentally the only tree) and kill [GS006].

subject: Sun's Song
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in the back of the Graveyard grants entry to the Composer Brothers' tomb where the Sun's Song is learned.

evidence.quote:
Proceed to the back of the graveyard  
and play Zelda's Lullaby to get into the composer brother's tomb, learn the 
sun's song and head back.

subject: Hylian Shield
text: The Hylian Shield and Piece of Heart PoH03 are found under the graves in the Graveyard at night.

evidence.quote:
Once in the graveyard play the Sun's Song and  
make it night time (it's midnight so Dampe's gone to sleep).  Now get the  
Hylian shield and [PoH03] from under the graves.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS007
text: Gold Skulltula GS007 is located behind the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Go back into Kakoriko and 
walk to behind the skullita house where you'll find [GS007].

subject: Gold Skulltula GS008
text: Gold Skulltula GS008 is located on the back of the brick pillar at the construction building.

evidence.quote:
Go to where  
the building is being constructed and you'll see [GS008] on the back of the
brick pillar.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS009
text: Gold Skulltula GS009 is visible when turning around while standing in front of the guard on the stairs.

evidence.quote:
Now run up the stairs toward the guard but turn around when  
you're in front of him and you'll see [GS009].

subject: Gold Skulltula GS010
text: Gold Skulltula GS010 is found on the ladder of the lookout tower and can be shot with the slingshot.

evidence.quote:
show the guard Zelda’s  
letter and go to the look out where you'll see [GS010] on the ladder.  Shot
it with your slingshot and collect the token on your way up.

subject: Piece of Heart PoH04
text: Jumping from the lookout tower onto the roof and speaking to the man sitting there rewards Piece of Heart PoH04.

evidence.quote: Now hold left and sidestep toward the left railing, jump as you get to it but keep holing left and link's screaming will be interrupted when he catches onto the seam of the fence nearest the building with the man sitting on it. Climb onto the fence then on to the building. Talk to the guy and get [PoH04].

subject: Bottle
text: Tossing all the stray Cuccos into the pen in Kakariko Village rewards a bottle.

evidence.quote:
start tossing  
the cuccos in the pen (I only explained that part cause they're the two  
hardest ones to get to).  Once you have the bottle run back to the  
graveyard.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS011
text: Releasing bottled bugs into the dirt mound in the left corner of the Graveyard produces Gold Skulltula GS011.

evidence.quote:
Now take the bugs to the dirt mound in the left corner of the grave yard  
and collect [GS011] (remember to rebottle one of your bugs...you'll need  
them).

subject: Adult's Wallet
text: The Adult's Wallet is collected from the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
On your way out of Kakoriko swing by the house of Skullita and pick 
up your Adult's Wallet.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS012
text: Rolling into the tree next to Talon's house at night reveals Gold Skulltula GS012.

evidence.quote:
run across the field to Lon Lon ranch  
(assuming it's night time when you enter) go to the only tree next to  
Talon's house and roll into it collecting [GS012].

subject: Gold Skulltula GS013
text: Gold Skulltula GS013 is found on a wooden section of the fence around the horse pen.

evidence.quote:
Make your way around 
the horse pen and you'll see a wooden section of the fence where you'll 
collect [GS013].

subject: Piece of Heart PoH05
text: Moving the corner milk box inside the tall pillar and crawling through the crawl space reveals Piece of Heart PoH05.

evidence.quote:
Continue across the field avoiding the birds to the tall 
pillar.  Walk into it and pull the corner milk box out a little, go through 
the crawl space and collect [PoH05].

subject: Epona's Song
text: Talking to Malon in the middle of the horse pen teaches Epona's Song.

evidence.quote:
Talk to Malon in the middle of the 
horse pen and learn Eponia's song

subject: Lon Lon Ranch Bottle
text: Winning Talon's Super Cucco minigame inside his house awards a second bottle.

evidence.quote:
go into Talon's house and win his cucco 
game to get the second bottle.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS014
text: Gold Skulltula GS014 is found behind the house to the immediate right upon entering Kokiri Forest at night.

evidence.quote:
Now go back to the lost woods (make sure it's  
night time when you enter).  Once there go behind the house to your  
immediate right and collect [GS014]

subject: Gold Skulltula GS015
text: Using bugs in the soil mound by the Kokiri Forest shop produces Gold Skulltula GS015.

evidence.quote:
by the shop use your bug in the soil to 
collect [GS015].

subject: Gold Skulltula GS016
text: Taking the first two lefts in the Lost Woods leads to a mound of soil holding Gold Skulltula GS016.

evidence.quote:
Now enter the lost woods, take the first two lefts and  
you'll see another mound of soil; collect [GS016].

subject: Bullet Bag Upgrade
text: Scoring 100 points three times in a row on the tree target in the Lost Woods awards the biggest seed bag.

evidence.quote:
Go strait  
and strait again which will put a tree in front of you with a bulls-eye  
hanging from it.  Shoot thee perfect bull's-eyes (score 100 points three  
times in a row) and collect the biggest seed bag.

subject: Piece of Heart PoH06
text: Playing the ocarina minigame with the two Skull Kids on the tree stump awards Piece of Heart PoH06.

evidence.quote:
Now jump down the ladder 
and you'll see two stalchilds on a long tree stump, play the ocarina with  
them and collect [PoH06].

subject: Gold Skulltula GS017
text: Planting bugs in the soil mound near the two Business Scrubs in the Lost Woods yields Gold Skulltula GS017.

evidence.quote:
go left again and you'll see two business scrubs  
near a mound of soil.  Kill the scrubs and plant your bugs in the soil to  
receive [GS017].

subject: Deku Stick Upgrade
text: Wearing the Skull Mask and walking onto the stage inside the hidden hole in the tall grass awards the second Deku Stick upgrade.

evidence.quote:
Now run in the tall mesh near the tree till you fall in a 
hole.  Put on the skull mask and walk out on the stage and collect the  
second stick upgrade.

subject: Piece of Heart PoH07
text: Playing Saria's Song for the Skull Kid while standing on the tree stump in the Lost Woods awards Piece of Heart PoH07.

evidence.quote:
Walk back into the lost woods and  
go left.  Stand on the tree stump and play Saria's song to collect [PoH07], 
show the stalchild the skeleton mask and he'll buy it.

subject: Goron's Bracelet
text: Playing Saria's Song for Darunia in his room on the bottom floor of Goron City grants the Goron's Bracelet.

evidence.quote:
Once there drop down to the bottom floor and play  
Zelda's lullaby to get into Durana's room.  Play Saria's song for him and  
collect the Goron's Bracelet.

subject: Piece of Heart PoH08
text: Throwing a bomb into the giant spinning pot in Goron City yields Piece of Heart PoH08 when it stops on the happy face.

evidence.quote:
Turn and run to the spinning pot and throw it in.  
When the bomb goes off  the pot will start spinning if it lands on the 
happy face (it'll land on  whatever face it's on when the cut scene begins) 
you'll collect [PoH08].

subject: Dodongo's Cavern Entrance
text: Throwing the bomb flower down the cliff opens the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote:
exit Goron City and take a right where you'll see a bomb flower  
partially fenced in.  Pick and throw the bomb flower down below opening the 
entrance to Dodongo's cavern.

subject: Piece of Heart PoH09
text: Backflipping over the fence opening above Dodongo's Cavern lands Link on the cliff edge to collect Piece of Heart PoH09.

evidence.quote:
Z-target so you can back flip over the lowered part in the fence  
landing you on the edge of the cliff above Dodongo's cavern.  Collect  
[PoH09]

subject: Gold Skulltula GS018
text: Using bugs in the mound of soft soil at the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern releases Gold Skulltula GS018.

evidence.quote:
now hop off of the cliff  
and you'll see a mound of soil at the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern, Use  
your bug there and collect [GS018].

subject: Gold Skulltula GS019
text: In the baby Dodongo area, luring a Dodongo to blow up the bombable wall on the left opens the room containing Gold Skulltula GS019.

evidence.quote:
In the area with the first baby  
dodongos there's a bombable wall on the left before the ground becomes  
elevated, lure a dodongo there and kill them so their death explosion  
clears out the wall.  Now go into the next room and collect [GS019].

subject: Gold Skulltula GS022
text: Bombing the strange wall along the trail toward Kakariko reveals Gold Skulltula GS022 on a climbable surface.

evidence.quote:
Take your bombs part of  
the way toward Kakoriko and you'll see a strange looking wall to your left, 
bomb it and there will be [GS022) (you can climb the wall it's on).

subject: Gold Skulltula GS023
text: Gold Skulltula GS023 is located inside a crate right by the entrance to Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote:
Run  
in and you'll see a crate by the entrance, inside is [GS023].

subject: Piece of Heart PoH10
text: Climbing down the wall indent to the right of a large cliff rock inside Death Mountain Crater yields Piece of Heart PoH10.

evidence.quote:
Go 
back out into the volcano and continue away from the way you came in and to 
the right of a large rock on the edge of the cliff.  Climb down the wall 
and into the indent where you'll find [PoH10].

subject: Spin Attack
text: Bombing the strange wall near the summit reveals a Great Fairy who bestows the sword spin technique.

evidence.quote:
Once outside bomb the strange  
looking wall and walk in there you'll find a Great Fairy.  After getting  
your sword spin go talk to the owl and let him take you to Kakoriko.

subject: Piece of Heart PoH11
text: Dropping off the cucco lady's roof into the Cucco pen area leads to a wall crack with Piece of Heart PoH11.

evidence.quote:
He'll 
set you down on top of the roof of the cucco lady's house.  Go to the right 
where the cucco pin is and drop down where you'll find your self next to a  
crack in the wall leading to [PoH11].

subject: Bomb Bag Upgrade
text: The Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Market offers a Bomb Bag upgrade and Piece of Heart PoH12 as prizes.

evidence.quote:
while  
you're there go to the bombchu bowling alley and pick up your first bomb  
bag upgrade and [PoH12].

subject: Din's Fire
text: Link can obtain Din's Fire as an optional spell at this point.

evidence.quote: Also, go get Din's fire though it's optional right now.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS024
text: Rolling into the tree near the entrance rocks and owl reveals Gold Skulltula GS024.

evidence.quote:
Before bombing the rocks talk to the owl and roll into the tree exposing  
[GS024].

subject: Magic Beans
text: Magic beans can be purchased at Zora's River starting at 10 rupees and increasing by 10 rupees per bean up to 10 beans.

evidence.quote: Bomb the rocks and go buy five magic beans leaving you with 50 rupees (the next one cost 60 rupees). Go break the circle of rocks, cut down the bushes, and float through the water to get 10 more rupees and buy the 6th beans.

subject: Singing Frogs
text: Playing songs for the frogs on the log earns Link 50 rupees for each new song played.

evidence.quote:
Walk out on 
the log and play your four of the songs for the frogs (you get 50 rupees 
for each new song you play them so after the third you'll be maxed out but 
you don't really need the money anyway).

subject: Soft Soil Patches
text: Gold Skulltulas can still be gathered from soft soil holes even after planting Magic Beans in them.

evidence.quote:
!!!!!Remember you can still collect gold Skullitas from holes even after 
!!!!!you've planted the beans there.

subject: Piece of Heart PoH13
text: Using a Cucco to glide past the ocarina platform to the high ledge allows Link to collect Piece of Heart PoH13.

evidence.quote:
Walk past the platform where you play the  
ocarina and jump using the cucco to glide you to the platform with the  
piece of heart.  To save trips try to land next to the piece of heart then  
get [PoH13].

subject: Piece of Heart PoH14
text: Gliding with a Cucco from the Gossip Stone platform toward the isolated ledge in the water retrieves Piece of Heart PoH14.

evidence.quote:
Take this cucco and  
walk across the thin wood bridge to where the gossip stone sits alone on a  
circular platform.  Jump with the cucco toward the [PoH14] on it's own  
little ledge sticking out of the water.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS025
text: Gold Skulltula GS025 appears at night on the ladder in the shallows near the entrance to Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote:
jump into the shallows next  
to the ladder.  Once it's night time you'll see [GS025] on the ladder.

subject: Piece of Heart PoH15
text: Lighting all four torches in Zora's Domain simultaneously using a Deku Stick spawns Piece of Heart PoH15 behind the waterfall.

evidence.quote:
Light a Deku stick and run down to the unlit torch and light it  
(it's one that never goes out)...Once it's lit hug the wall and keep rolling till you're under the  
waterfall and light the two remaining torches.  When all four are lit at  
once you'll get [PoH15].

subject: Silver Scale
text: Winning the diving game by collecting the thrown rupees at the top of the waterfall rewards the Silver Scale.

evidence.quote:
play the diving game (you actually make money since it cost 30 and he  
throws 6-7 rupees worth 5 each).  Collect the rupees and go get the silver  
scale.

subject: Ruto's Letter
text: Diving through the underwater warp hole leads to Lake Hylia, where Link can grab a bottle containing a letter.

evidence.quote:
Now head dive into the hole and go to lake Hylia.  Grab the bottle  
with a letter in it and swim shore where you'll see two scarecrows.

subject: Scarecrow's Song
text: The scarecrow farthest from the shore at Lake Hylia asks Link to compose and play an 8-note song.

evidence.quote:
swim shore where you'll see two scarecrows.  The  
one farthest from the water will ask for an 8 note song so make one up.

subject: Stone of Agony
text: In Kakariko, walk back out and collect the Stone of Agony.

evidence.quote:
After getting  
your sword spin go talk to the owl and let him take you to Kakoriko....Walk back out and collect your Stone 
of Agony (very fitting name if you already know where everything is).
